title: Reading ComfyUI's console during a run
hook: Which backend, which format, how much loaded, how fast, and why the progress bar may understate the wait. It's all printed. Learn to read it.

verified.claim: Each quoted line is formatted by the log call named in the lesson.
verified.ref: server.py, main.py, comfy/sd.py, comfy/model_management.py, comfy/model_patcher.py, execution.py

verified.claim: The job in the Lab is real: lines and times copied from one run on our test machine.
With dynamic VRAM, model_trange moves the bar's start time after step 2, to take load overhead out of the rate.
Prompt executed in N seconds is logged at the end of each job, with no check for success in that branch.
On a run here the log held a timestamp per write, and validation failures, exceptions and the OOM line come from execution.py.

unchecked: The example load lines labelled as ours have real wording and made-up numbers.
One job's times show one job. The gap between bar and clock will differ per model and card.
Custom node packs print their own lines, which this lesson can't cover.
